scheme_name: Workers In Case Of His Partial Permanent Disablement-JKBOCWWB
other_conditions: The applicant must have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
The worker must be a registered member of the Building and Other Construction Workers (BOC) Welfare Board.
The scheme applies to workers who suffer from partial permanent disablement.
benefits_summary: Provides Rs. 1,00,000 to registered BOC workers in case of partial permanent disablement.
